status: frozen before reprocessing, flare cleaning, source-image inspection, shock-front fitting, source construction, or opening any replacement-cluster lensing target
pre_image_execution_correction: The first provenance assertion looked for CHECK_VF_PHA as an output FITS keyword. CIAO records this chandra_repro parameter in tool history rather than as that header keyword. Version 1.0.1 verifies the exact check_vf_pha history value. All 20 calibrated products may be reused because the original commands were correct; no event image, shock fit, source construction, lensing target, or gravity score was opened.
runtime_discovery_note: After v19E acquisition completed, the already-audited isolated Sigma v17A CIAO environment was found intact in WSL. V19F reuses that exact environment and its passed 37-test audit instead of installing or selecting a new calibration stack.
purpose: Produce current-calibration, source-only Chandra event and blank-sky products for the preregistered Bullet Cluster and Abell 2146 mechanism-development pair using one inherited reduction protocol.

runtime.support_caveat: The Chandra X-ray Center documents a WSL installation route but does not formally support WSL as a CIAO platform.

event_reprocessing.shared_settings: inherit event_reprocessing from the hashed Sigma v17A reduction config
event_reprocessing.check_vf_pha_rule: yes only when the archived DATAMODE is VFAINT; no for the single declared FAINT observation

cleaning.shared_settings: inherit flare_filtering, point_sources, and background verbatim from the hashed Sigma v17A reduction config
cleaning.flare_algorithm: iterative symmetric 3-sigma clipping about the quiescent mean until membership is unchanged
cleaning.background: per-observation CALDB ACIS blank sky, particle weighted and normalized in 9-12 keV

gates.failure_rule: Fail the observation or pair; do not change calibration, flare threshold, source threshold, energy band, or background rule for one cluster.

next_protocol_boundary: Freeze the absolute/relative registration, common source-map grid, surface-brightness edge detector, resolved spectral bins, shock-front uncertainty fit, and projection ensemble before visually inspecting any v19F image.
claim_boundary: V19F is detector reduction only and contains no new gravity formula or fitted gravity parameter.
No event image may be visually inspected during v19F; only machine-readable headers, counts, exposure, warnings, and gate statistics may be read.
No lensing coordinate, inferred halo map, strong-lensing model, or holdout target is opened.
Passing v19F does not construct a shock front, assembly clock, causal source, or root equation.
The older Bullet ObsID 554 is processed in its archived FAINT mode without VFAINT background cleaning; this is a declared detector fact, not an object-specific physics parameter.
